notes: Engine copies live in public/vendor/quaternius/universal-base-characters. PNG textures were resized to 1024px max with Lanczos. The raw zip was not edited. Two broken image URIs (T_Hair_1_Normal_png.png, T_Eye_Normal_png.png) were corrected only in the engine glTF. Body scale is 1 meter. Underwear torso, arms, and legs are hidden at runtime; eyes, brows, and separate hair stay.
